topic.title: Icons
topic.shortdesc: When enabled, DITA Bootstrap includes Bootstrap Icons by default. Additional icon libraries such as Font Awesome Feather and Octicons can also be added using command line parameters.

section.title: Bootstrap Icons
section.p: Bootstrap Icons is a growing library of SVG icons that are designed by @mdo and maintained by the Bootstrap Team. They are open source and licensed under MIT, just like Bootstrap so the icon set is freely available to everyone. A Link to the default Bootstrap Icons CDN set is included by default.

section.title: Example
section.p: Icon fonts with classes for every icon are included in Bootstrap Icons. Include the icon web fonts in your page via CSS, then reference the class names as needed in your DITA (e.g., icon outputclass="bi-alarm"/).
Use a style attribute and alter the CSS font-size and color to change the icon appearance.

body.p: Icons can also be placed within buttons as shown:

section.title: Specialization
section.codeblock: <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-arrow-down-square-fill"/> </button> <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-chat-left-quote-fill"/> </button> <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-speedometer"/> </button> <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-camera-fill"/> </button> <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-link"/> </button> <button outputclass="btn-floating m-1" href="#"> <icon outputclass="bi-share-fill"/> </button>

body.p: Icons can also be used within chapter headings, and topicref elements by adding othermeta name="icon" and othermeta name="icon-style" elements.

fig.title: Icons elements within a menu bar

body.codeblock: <chapter> <topicmeta> <navtitle>Extend</navtitle> <othermeta name="icon" content="bi-tools"/> <othermeta name="icon-style" content="color: var(--bs-blue)"/> </topicmeta> <topicref navtitle="Icons" format="dita" type="topic" href="icons.dita"> <topicmeta> <othermeta name="icon" content="bi-images"/> </topicmeta> </topicref> ... </chapter>

section.title: Installing other icons
section.p: Other icon sets such as Font Awesome Feather and Octicons are available. To use an alternative set of icons, modify the sample header or specify the path of the Icons CDN file using the --icons.cdn.path parameter.

section.title: Excluding icons
section.p: For performance reasons, if you don't need any icons you can exclude them by setting the --icons.include=no
